messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — NewCo wants the POC next week. Key asks: 1) SSO with multiple IdPs and routing by customer subdomain (login.customer.example.com -> specific IdP), 2) SCIM group sync with near-real-time delta, 3) RBAC mapping from SCIM groups to app roles, 4) domain proofing for tenant isolation, and 5) pricing impact if they bulk-provision 50k users at kickoff. Can eng/security confirm constraints?
Maria: thanks — routing by subdomain is doable. our usual approach: map incoming `Host` or `email_domain` to tenant config and forward to tenant's IdP via relay. domain proof we do via DNS TXT or admin email control. will outline steps for the customer. :white_check_mark:
Samir: tech details: SAML flow is fine but watch assertion size + relay state. if they have lots of group claims we recommend returning only group IDs and then querying SCIM for full group membership to avoid >8k assertions. session timeout: we support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows and honor the Assertion/SessionNotOnOrAfter. for routing, we can do a simple policy table keyed by primary domain or subdomain.
Samir: SCIM notes: we support SCIM 2.0 delta syncs (PATCH for group membership) and full bulk imports. practical limits: 100 reqs/min per org default; page size up to 1000. for initial bulk import do a full /Users import then enable delta. example PATCH to add a user to a group: ```PATCH /Groups/{id} Content-Type: application/json { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{ "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{ "value": "user-123" }] }] }```
Jordan: security checkboxes: require a service account with SCIM write scope (rotating creds recommended), audit logs for provisioning events stored for 1 year (we can extend), and KMS-backed keying for SAML metadata signing if they need BYOK. also need an ATO checklist item: admin user proofing (DNS TXT recommended for ownership) and SSO fallback plan if IdP unreachable.
Alex: pricing — they asked if Hosted usage will spike because of provisioning churn (lots of SCIM calls + auth events). Maria, does this push them to Dedicated or just an enterprise support add-on?
Maria: SCIM/auth events are low-CPU network ops, not GPU. Hosted pricing applies (requests and tokens) but provisioning bursts are rate-limited; for large initial import we recommend a one-time migration service (billable) or temporarily raising rate limits under an agreement. Dedicated is only required for inference throughput, not for auth plumbing.
Samir: practical POC plan: 1) get test metadata from their IdPs (SAML metadata XML or OIDC issuer and client creds), 2) create a staging tenant and two subdomains to demo routing, 3) run a full SCIM import (we can do a dry-run), 4) configure RBAC mapping UI: map SCIM group names -> role slugs, 5) verify audit logs + TTL. I can own the staging setup if Maria creates creds.
Alex: action items: @Maria send POC checklist + sample DNS TXT instructions to customer; @Samir stand up staging tenant and share endpoints; @Jordan confirm audit log retention & BYOK notes for contract. I'll loop in account exec for pricing.
id-bot: deploy note — staging tenant created (id: staging-newco-01) by Samir at 2026-03-22T15:02:xxZ
Maria: I'll draft the checklist and a short runbook for the kickoff call. pushing to the calendar once Samir confirms times.
Alex: perfect. can we also get a quick note for the sales quote: one-time migration fee + potential temporary rate bump? keep it high-level for now.
Samir: will include a tech appendix with recommended SCIM retry/backoff and a fallback script to bulk import CSV if their SCIM provider has throttling issues.
Jordan: I'll add a bullet about PoLP for the service account and a note requiring separate admin for domain proof.
Alex: thanks team — I'll schedule the pre-POC sync with NewCo tomorrow. :calendar:
